results.content: # Expert Insights Saturday: Dr. Jane Smith on the Future of AI in Healthcare. Expert Insights Saturday: Dr. Jane Smith on the Future of AI in Healthcare. For this week’s Expert Insights Saturday, I’m thrilled to share some incredible insights from Dr. Jane Smith, a leading expert in AI and healthcare innovation. Dr. Smith points to projects like the one at her institution, where AI models predict patient responses to different therapies, allowing for more effective and personalized treatment plans. Dr. Smith also notes the potential of AI to assist in real-time decision-making during surgeries, further improving patient outcomes. Dr. Smith discusses how AI can analyze data from wearable devices to monitor patients’ health in real time, providing early warnings for conditions such as heart disease or diabetes. Dr. Smith points to AI-powered apps like Woebot and Wysa, which provide mental health support through chatbots that use natural language processing to understand and respond to users’ concerns.
